Online Assistance Services

Contact Jan Seva Point from home for help with these online tasks. Confirm availability, documents and any fee for your request before starting.

Online form filling

Government job applications, college admission forms, scholarship applications and entrance exam registration.

Office visit: usually not required.

Document & PDF help

Online application PDFs, admit cards and results; form-correction guidance; document scanning, resizing and PDF merging.

Bill-payment assistance

Electricity bills, mobile/DTH recharge and payment-receipt downloads. Water-bill assistance is available where an online facility exists.

Status & online guidance

Application status checks, appointment-booking assistance, scheme-eligibility information, online-registration guidance and application-receipt downloads.

Whether another service needs a centre visit must be confirmed with Jan Seva Point. Online assistance does not guarantee approval, eligibility or a benefit payment.
